name: Attention
tagline: AI sales agents that learn from your best calls to automate CRM and coaching.
description: Attention records and transcribes sales conversations, then uses AI agents trained on a team's best calls to auto-update the CRM, draft follow-ups, score reps against coaching scorecards, and surface forecasting and deal insights. It connects to dialers, meeting tools, and CRMs like Salesforce and HubSpot to cut manual data entry across go-to-market workflows.
insight: Raised a $14M Series A led by French VC Alven in November 2024.
edge: Learns from your top reps' winning calls to auto-update the CRM and coach live, going beyond passive call transcription.
cons: No public pricing or free tier

references.title: Attention Raises $14M by Automating Sales Calls and Adding $1.2M to Its Pipeline
